assign.card: Whisper log: the raw stream, structured

log.msg: Steps 1-2 committed on worktree/whisper-log: WhisperLog (audio/Whisper) is one numbered event log (seq, run, t, src, kind, msg plus every extra field) appended to the existing ai/whisper/<date>.jsonl day file via FsFile - one store, already tailed by JSONL.live(). WhisperLogRows holds the read rules (diff, amend, duplicate). Dictate now reports req, segment, stale drops and the whole verbose_json reply (+70 ms per 8 s clip, so only a logged mic uses it). Page at /framework/audio/Whisper/log/. Whisper :8178 is up.

findings.text: The new page is unproven: every shot of /framework/audio/Whisper/log/ shows "Page Load Error — 404" (page 1) because the shots were taken on monorepo.localhost, the main tree, where `audio/Whisper/log/page.js` does not exist yet (it lives only on `worktree/whisper-log`, 0e3d2301e). Re-shoot from the worktree (or a private server on the branch) before merge; every layout answer below is "not measured" until then.

The parent Whisper page shots also predate the change: no "log" child appears in its nav or tabs at any width (shots/…-audio-Whisper/sheet.png), so "reachable by a visible link" (requirement 3) cannot be confirmed from evidence. The diff does add `children: "log"` and a readme link, so it should pass once re-shot.

`.wl` sizes itself by the viewport, `inline-size: max(20rem, calc(100vw - 24rem))`, ignoring the page's own column; at 3440 that is ~3056 px, and at 400 it is 320 px inside a ~344 px column with a 62em min-width row, so the table relies on horizontal scroll inside `.wl-rows`. Check both ends once the page renders (layout: sizing).

`ux/Dictate/WhisperLog.css` is left behind: the old class loaded it, the new re-export does not, so it is now an orphan stylesheet. Fine to keep (never destructive), but the Dictate readme/doc should say it is unused.

Every logged Whisper reply now stores the full `verbose_json` body in `server`, and identical interim guesses are no longer skipped (the old `record` skipped them), so the day file grows much faster on a logged mic. Intended for debugging; worth one line in `doc/whisper-log.md`.
